This is a bail application U/S.439 of Cr.P.C. by the Petitioner for grant of bail in connection with Joda P.S. Case No. 275 of 2022 corresponding to Spl. Case No. 404 of 2022 pending in the file of learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge(POCSO), Keonjhar for commission of offences punishable Under Sections 450/342/376- AB/376(2)(f)/506 of IPC r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act, on the allegation of committing rape and aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the victim-child aged about 9 years by confining her in a room.
3.

sentences.text: In the course of hearing of the bail application, Mr. S. Mishra, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the medical evidence absolutely does not support the allegation and the Petitioner is the relative of the Informant and out of grudge, the present Petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that in the meanwhile, after completion of investigation,
charge-sheet has already been filed, but the Petitioner is languishing inside jail custody since 26.09.2022 and, therefore, the Petitioner may kindly be granted bail.
4. On the other hand, Mr. S.R. Roul, learned ASC prays to reject the bail application of the Petitioner by placing the facts of the case.

5. After having considered the rival submissions made and taking into consideration the nature and gravity of accusations raised against the Petitioner and keeping in mind the age of the victim-child Santosh Behera @ Santu Behera vs State Of Odisha ...
